about_the_game:
Trust your friends and build the ultimate burger! ...But not everyone is truly on your side.

Jinro Burger is a social deduction game of cooperation and betrayal where friendships are built, or completely shattered, over burgers. Can you see through the lies and sabotage of the Spy hidden in your kitchen and satisfy your customers?

【A Cooking Time Full of Suspicion】

Players are secretly divided into two teams: "Staff" and "Spies." Work together to assemble a single hamburger. If the burger stands tall without falling apart, the Staff wins! However, if the cooking fails due to a Spy's sabotage... a heated discussion begins, followed by a vote to kick out the most suspicious person. Can you trust the words of your fellow chefs?

【Unpredictable Orders, Every Time】

Every customer has unique tastes. You'll have to meet requests like "Make it as tall as possible!" or "I want a burger with lots of ingredients!" while also avoiding the secret ingredient each customer hates. Spies can spread false information about these disliked ingredients to throw the kitchen into chaos. Who is telling the truth, and who is lying? Organize the information and craft the perfect burger.

【Fun with Friends in Party Mode】

Jinro Burger can be played with up to 6 players. Enjoy a variety of ways to play, from a casual Quick Mode to the strategic Standard Mode where identifying false information and calculating scores is key. You can also freely customize the rules. Utilize each character's unique passive skills to claim victory. Each game takes 20 to 30 minutes, so even beginners who have never played a Werewolf-type game can enjoy it.

【A Solo Deep-Dive in Story Mode】

"Nervous about playing online right away?" No problem. Enjoy a story woven by unique characters and learn the game's rules naturally as you play. This mode is also perfect for when you just want to play by yourself.

```

An era of abundance. Amidst a frenzy of "Insta-worthy" food creations, dark rumors surround "Hell's Kitchen," a mysterious burger

joint that has surged in popularity.

Michael, a timid angel sent to sabotage the business, operates in the shadows, but is unfortunately caught by the staff...

Just as he was surrounded by thugs and about to lose everything, never to return home, a mysterious figure stepped in to protect

him.

But why? Who is this mysterious individual? And will Michael succeed in taking down the burger empire!?

```

Now, let the ultimate burger-making, and the ultimate deception, begin. Why don't you step into the kitchen and take on this thrilling cooking challenge?
